entries.en: Rolfe Hawthorne would share further knowledge to assist you in befriending the sylphs.
entries.fr: Rolfe Hawthorne peut vous aider à choisir des cadeaux pour les Sylphes.
entries.ja: ホウソーンの山塞のロルフ・ホウソーンは、シルフへの手土産について助言をしたいようだ。
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Rolfe tells you that it would be unwise to greet the sylphs without a proper gift, but he has trouble remembering exactly what that gift should be. However, it is possible that his wife, Rosa, can tell you. Speak with her at Fullflower Comb to see what she has to say.
entries.fr: Rolfe vous a envoyé demander son avis à sa femme Rosa, au rucher de Pleinefleur. Retournez la voir une fois de plus pour lui demander son avis.
entries.ja: シルフ族が好きなものは、フルフラワー養蜂場にいる彼の妻「ロサ・ホウソーン」が詳しいようだ。彼女に聞いてみよう。

entries.en: Though she does not fully understand why, Rosa informs you that the sylphs are said to be quite fond of milkroot, which can be obtained from ochus. In order to find one such ochu, take the amber syrup given to you by Rosa and pour it on the curious tussock in the Honey Yard. Once uncovered, slay the ochu, and pray that you find some milkroot among its remains.

entries.en: Rolfe immediately recognizes the milkroot upon your presentation of it, and is sure that the sylphs will appreciate the offering. Just take care not to inhale too many of the fumes yourself before giving it to the sylphs.

entries.ja: シルフ族にとって、とは酒のようなものらしい。もっともロルフ・ホウソーンは、それを苦手としているようだ……。

entries.en: Oh, still here, eh? Great! There's one more thing you should know about the sylphs. They don't take kindly to guests who show up empty-handed. To earn their trust, you'd do well to bring along a...a... Uh...
entries.fr: Vous savez, si vous allez à la rencontre des Sylphes, il serait bon d'arriver avec un présent. Mais j'avoue que je ne saurais pas trop quoi vous conseiller...

とはいえ、オレはシルフ族の好みは知らなくてな……。

entries.en: A peace offering for the sylphs? Were it anyone else, I'd recommend a jar of honey, but I fear that wouldn't get you past their front doorstep, dear. No, their tastes run more to the unusual.

entries.en: Are you, perchance, familiar with milkroot? That's what we call the root of that most fiendish seedkin, the ochu. When chewed, it exudes a cloudy liquid that's said to induce curious visions in the imbiber. You'd not catch me dead trying the stuff, but the sylphs seem to enjoy it to no end.
entries.fr: Ils préfèrent les choses plus... terre à terre. Je pense qu' leur ferait plaisir. Ce sont des racines qui proviennent des monstres de la famille des végétaux. Les Sylphes raffolent de leur jus blanc, ça a le don de les émoustiller.
